summary: Beasley Broadcast Group, via its subsidiary Beasley Mezzanine Holdings, announced the expiration and final results of debt exchange and tender offers plus consent solicitations. The Exchange Offer exchanged 99.53% of existing 9.200% Senior Secured Second Lien Notes due 2028 for newly issued 10.000% Senior Secured Second Lien PIK Notes due 2027 at a 50% exchange ratio ($500 per $1,000 principal). The Tender Offer purchased $15.9M of existing 11.000% Senior Secured First Lien Notes due 2028 at par. Consents to amend indentures and release collateral on second lien notes were obtained. Settlement expected around April 30, 2026. Watch for impact of PIK interest and potential further liability management.
